select count(*) from studycafe
where studycafe_addr LIKE '%'||#{region}||'%'

select st.ticket_idx, st.ticket_name, st.ticket_amount, st.ticket_time, tc.ticket_category_name from studycafe_ticket st join ticket_category tc on st.ticket_category_idx = tc.ticket_category_idx where tc.ticket_category_idx = #{ticket_category_idx} and studycafe_idx = #{studycafe_idx}
select ticket_amount from studycafe_ticket where ticket_idx = #{ticket_idx}
select ticket_time from studycafe_ticket where ticket_idx = #{ticket_idx}
select seat_idx, seat_num, seat_type, seat_status, seat_x, seat_y, seat_w, seat_h, studycafe_idx from seat where studycafe_idx = #{studycafe_idx}
select * from studycafe_reservation sr join studycafe_pay sp on sr.paymentId = sp.paymentId where sr.seat_idx = #{seat_idx} and sp.pay_status = 'PAID' and sr.reservation_endtime > systimestamp
mapper.insert: insert into studycafe_pay (paymentId, orderName, totalAmount, pay_status, user_idx, paidAt) values(#{paymentId}, #{orderName}, #{totalAmount}, 'PENDING', #{user_idx}, systimestamp)
mapper.update: update studycafe_pay set storeId = #{storeId}, orderName = #{orderName}, totalAmount = #{totalAmount}, pay_status = #{pay_status}, pay_method = #{pay_method}, paidAt = #{paidAt}, statusChangedAt= #{statusChangedAt}, paid = #{paid}, pgProvider = #{pgProvider}, vat = #{vat}, supply = #{supply} where paymentId = #{paymentId} and pay_status = 'PENDING'
update seat set seat_status = 'RESERVED' where seat_idx = #{seat_idx} and seat_status = 'FREE'
mapper.insert: insert into studycafe_reservation (reservation_idx, user_idx, seat_idx, reservation_starttime, reservation_endtime, reservation_status, ticket_idx, paymentId) values (reservation_idx.nextval,#{user_idx}, #{seat_idx}, #{reservation_starttime}, #{reservation_endtime}, 'RESERVED', #{ticket_idx}, #{paymentId})
mapper.select: select paymentId, storeId, orderName, paid, user_idx, pay_method, pay_status, statusChangedAt, paidAt, totalAmount, pgProvider, vat, supply from studycafe_pay where paymentId = #{paymentId}
mapper.update: update seat s set seat_status = 'FREE' where seat_status = 'RESERVED' and not exists (select s.seat_idx from studycafe_reservation r join studycafe_pay p on r.paymentId = p.paymentId where r.seat_idx = s.seat_idx and r.reservation_status = 'RESERVED' and p.pay_status = 'PAID' and systimestamp between r.reservation_starttime and r.reservation_endtime)
